record.question: Which country's Indian Embassy organized the 'Gandhi Cycle Rally for Peace' to march the 150th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi?
record.explanation: Answer B: Saudi Arabia. The Indian Consulate in Jeddah held the Gandhi Cycle Rally for Peace in Saudi Arabia in June 2019. Reference: https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/568024/SAUDI-ARABIA/Sheikh-holds-cycle-rally-for-peace-amp-tree-planting-to-mark-Mahatma%40150. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
